## Checklist
- [ ] `swift test` passes
- [ ] Tests added or updated for logic changes (no real hardware, no permissions needed)
- [ ] Anything that takes over input or writes to hardware is released on stop and on quit
- [ ] No code copied from GPL/copyleft projects; any outside code is credited here and in `THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md`
- [ ] No personal data (serials, UUIDs, clipboard contents, `/Users/...` paths)
